visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens inside a brightly lit retail drugstore with aisles of cosmetic products. A person's hands apply a white cream to their skin for demonstration. In the background, shelves are stocked with various beauty items. Large orange and white text overlays introduce the 2025 January/February new product update update. (2) A hand wearing a black quilted puffer jacket picks up a blue and silver packaged D-UP mascara base from a store display. The person examines the packaging closely. The background consists of numerous other D-UP products. Captions highlight the product's features while the person turns the packaging. (3) The focus shifts to a Visee product display. A person holds a square, clear compact of three-color face powder. They open the lid and use a small beige puff to rub the powder onto their hand. The store lighting reflects off the plastic packaging. (4) A display for the brand Upt is shown, featuring pink boxes. A hand picks up a tube of skin base cream labeled as a sample. The person holds the tube against the shelf background. Promotional posters with a female model's face are visible. (5) A hand holds a bright yellow tube of SERUMYU hand gel. The person squeezes a small amount of clear yellow gel onto their hand and massages it in. The background shows various hand care products. Detailed text overlays explain the gel's benefits and usage. (6) The camera focuses on a Kate display rack with small tubes of eyeshadow base in various colors. A hand selects one purple tube for a close-up examination. The shelf labels show pricing and color variations. The lighting is sharp and even. (7) A translucent purple bottle of unlabel LAB exosome essence is showcased. A hand holds the bottle up, showing the liquid inside and the label. The background remains the busy drugstore aisle with many overlapping product labels and price tags. Text summarizes the popularity. (8) The final shot returns to a wide view of the drugstore aisle. A large pink and white question overlay asks for user feedback. Social media icons and brand logos for 'japanuts' appear on the screen, encouraging viewers to like, comment, and share.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. [Slogan]: 2025年 1.2月號 日本藥妝 近期新品. (2) [Slogan]: D-UP 睫毛底膏. [Subtitle]: PLAZA限定. 我本來就蠻愛D-UP的睫毛膏 沒想到竟然出了睫毛底膏! 號稱塗了可以維持捲度到晚上 感覺很厲害. (3) [Slogan]: Visee 三色蜜粉. [Subtitle]: 一盒裡面 包含三種顏色的蜜粉! 它有兩個色號. #01 透明感 (冷色調). #02 血色感 (暖色調). 粉感超級低 是自然清透的感覺 偽素顏妝容必備. (4) [Slogan]: Upt 妝前乳. [Subtitle]: 這個是安達祐實監製的品牌 新出的妝前乳 質地很滋潤可以校正膚色 懶得化妝直接擦它也OK. (5) [Slogan]: SERUMYU 護手霜. [Subtitle]: 裡面有添加維他命VC和CICA 吸收度很好 完全不黏膩 擦完滑手機 不用擔心會沾到螢幕! (6) [Slogan]: Kate 眼影底膏. [Subtitle]: 之前的的人氣商品 現在又回歸啦 總共4色! 校色過的眼皮 能讓眼影更加接近原始顏色 也可以更持久唷. (7) [Slogan]: unlabel LAB 外泌體精華. [Subtitle]: 日本最近好多外泌體保養品 unlabel LAB也出了! 紫色包裝超搶眼 各大藥妝店都看得到. (8) [Variety]: 你對哪個 最有興趣? 快留言跟我分享. (9) [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. japanuts.com. @japanuts. 按讚 留言 分享.
